The net profit margin has dramatically shrunk from (negative) -0.12 to -0.09. This substantial decrease in profitability is the most worrying trend.  Earnings per share (EPS) decreased.

**Overall Assessment:**

The balance sheet shows a mixed picture with slightly better liquidity but some weakening in asset base and increased debt. However, the income statement paints a far more concerning picture. The decline in net income, coupled with rising interest expenses and declining profitability margins, significantly drags down the overall sentiment score. While sales increased marginally, it was not enough to offset the negative impacts on profitability.  The increase in Interest expense seems to be a key contributor to the drop in profit. The company's ability to manage its debt and control costs will be crucial in the coming period. 

The combination of these factors results in a slightly negative sentiment score (-0.65) with high confidence due to the magnitude of the net income decrease and related margin compression.
